name: Morgen
tagline: Your calendar is planned. Now hand off the work around it.
metaTitle: Morgen Alternative: AI Assistant for Email, Calendar, Tasks
metaDescription: Looking for a Morgen alternative? GAIA handles email, calendar and tasks in one assistant, runs workflows across your tools and works from your chat apps.
whyPeopleLook: Morgen is one of the better calendar apps around: every calendar in one place, tasks pulled in from your tools and an AI Planner that keeps them time-blocked. People look for an alternative when the calendar is under control but the work around it is not. Email still needs replies, meetings still need coordinating and chores repeat, and Morgen leaves email triage to Kai, a separate product with its own subscription.

faqs.question: What is the best Morgen alternative?
faqs.answer: If you want another calendar with automatic time-blocking, Motion, Reclaim and Akiflow are the closest. If you want an assistant that handles the email, scheduling and recurring work around your calendar, GAIA is a better fit.

faqs.question: Does GAIA replace Morgen's calendar app?
faqs.answer: No. GAIA is not a calendar app and does not unify Apple, Fastmail or CalDAV calendars. It works on your Google Calendar from chat, the web and the desktop. Many people keep a calendar app and let GAIA handle the work around it.

faqs.question: How much does GAIA cost?
faqs.answer: GAIA's hosted service is a paid subscription per person, with Pro at ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month, and GAIA Enterprise is priced on request. The code is source-available under the PolyForm Noncommercial license, so self-hosting is free for personal, noncommercial use, and for-profit organizations self-host under an enterprise license (contact the GAIA team).

faqs.question: How do I switch from Morgen to GAIA?
faqs.answer: Connect your calendar, email and task tools to GAIA, tell it your working hours, then move one recurring chore at a time into a workflow.
